name: project ATMOSPHERE
source:
A Sci-Fi visual novel inspired by games like Cyberpunk 2077 and the Deus Ex series.

The main character is a young man who just recently graduated from university. Who by unfortunate circumstances gets involved in an epic quest to decide the fate of his universe.

Throughout the story you will explore this new reality as an agent of the «Atmosphere agency» and help them in their fight with threats from another universe.

During your journey through «project ATMOSPHERE» story you will meet many characters each with their own unique story. Some of them could become your partners or friends on your mission to protect our world from invasion.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/drmad]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一部受《赛博朋克2077》和《杀出重围》系列等游戏启发的科幻视觉小说。

主角是一个刚从大学毕业的年轻人。他在不幸的情况下卷入了一场史诗般的探索，以决定他的宇宙的命运。

在整个故事中，你将作为“大气机构”的特工探索这个新现实，并帮助他们对抗来自另一个宇宙的威胁。

在你的“项目氛围”故事之旅中，你会遇到许多角色，每个角色都有自己独特的故事。他们中的一些人可能会成为你的合作伙伴或朋友，履行你保护我们的世界免受入侵的使命。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/drmad]Patreon[/url]]
